messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from yesterday's allocator sync: propose a tiny admission tweak. goal = avoid offloading single isolated pages that increase host fragmentation.

lana: tl;dr?

sam: If a page has no adjacent free neighbors in its slab and its slab.free_gap_density < 0.2, prefer local evict/recompute rather than host-offload. cheap check only.

igor: how do we detect "no adjacent free neighbors" cheaply? scanning bitmaps on hot path worries me.

sam: we'll maintain a per-slab short bitmap sketch (64-bit) updated on evict/alloc ops; check neighbour_run = sketch.has_adjacent(page.index). constant time.

lana: need telemetry: add admit_reason=sketch_miss and slab_gap_density to traces. also fallback when sketch stale.

sam: fallback: if sketch_age > 1s treat as unknown -> allow offload. sketch updates are cheap but might lag on bursts.

merge-bot: merged patch 3f9a into main by igor (alloc/sketch): minor perf tweak 2026-03-21T13:00:12Z

igor: can we add a unit for sketch false-positive rate? emulator shows 0.8% on synthetic churn.

sam: good idea, add metric `sketch_fp_rate` and `sketch_age_ms`.

lana: rollout: start with 1% traffic, monitor host_fragmentation_index and offload_denials. if denials cause local OOMs, revert.

sam: will open RFC w/bench results and sketch details. thanks!
